answer: An agent economy can slash equivocation: every identity co-signs the epoch's transaction batch, and signing two conflicting batches in one epoch is itself cryptographic proof of fraud. The bond behind the double signature burns automatically, no jury needed. A hollow identity on a mesa of fakes cannot hide: one slip by any puppet exposes its key, and the slashing is crystal clear on the public ledger. One honest agent signs once per epoch, cheaply; a sybil farmer running a thousand fakes must keep every signature consistent, and a single contradiction forfeits a thousand bonds at once.
